identity.name: Davide Imola
identity.headline: Tech Lead · Speaker · Open Source Builder
identity.summary: Tech Lead at RedCarbon, where I own the technical direction across the platform and build the AI agents that run on it. Ten years in DevOps and platform engineering before that: Go, Kubernetes, GitOps, DDD. I work at the intersection of AI that does real security work and security for the code AI writes. Co-founder of Schrodinger Hat and co-organizer of Open Source Day, Italy's largest free-access open source conference.

roles.summary: Technical direction for platform engineering, from frontend to infrastructure, plus the AI agents built on top.
bullets: Own the technical decisions across the whole platform, coordinating with the AI and security teams
Build AI agents for threat detection and security review on a Go microservices platform
Still writing code daily: the role is technical direction, not stepping back from engineering

roles.summary: Backend engineering on a multi-tenant AI cybersecurity platform. Grew into the tech lead role from here.
bullets: Designed and maintained Go microservices and the GCP/Kubernetes infrastructure behind them
gRPC service communication, Next.js product frontend

roles.summary: Last-mile delivery platform. Reliability and observability on AWS.
bullets: Built and scaled high-availability, multi-tenant AWS infrastructure
Kafka, PostgreSQL, Datadog; improved developer experience with CI/CD and ChatOps
Built the deployment pipelines and containerized legacy systems with Docker
C# on the product side, Linux distributions on the infrastructure side

roles.summary: Internship turned first job. Where engineering got serious.
bullets: Embedded systems in C++ and Qt; ported a Qt application to iOS and shipped it

Moved the FantaCulo platform onto Kubernetes and designed its cloud-native infrastructure. A project I helped because I liked it.
Wrote and delivered the Infrastructure as Code, DevOps and Cloud Security modules of the Cloud Engineer career path.
International open source community, 20k+ people reached across Europe, 100+ speakers hosted.
Italy's largest free-access open source conference. 500+ attendees, international speakers, free for everyone.
